routes.name: Universal Classifier
routes.description: Classifies ALL events (Docker, Edge, Journal, Syslog, Sophos) via universal_classifier pipeline. Sets classification field. Non-final: events continue to routing below.

routes.name: ALL to Elasticsearch
routes.description: ES-First: ALL events go to Elasticsearch as primary data lake. Non-final: events continue to SIEM/S3 routing.

routes.name: SIEM to Splunk
routes.description: SIEM-classified events go ADDITIONALLY to Splunk HEC for SOC analysis (10.10.0.66:8088). Final: stops here.

routes.name: Ops to S3 Archive
routes.description: Operational events go to MinIO S3 for long-term archival. Final: already in ES via route_all_to_es.

routes.name: Default Catch-All
routes.description: Safety net: any unclassified/fallback events already in ES via route_all_to_es. Final catch-all.
